sections.description:
DIRECTORATE OF RECLAMATION AND PROBATION (DELEGATION OF POWERS) RULES,
1984
DIRECTORATE OF RECLAMATION
AND PROBATION (DELEGATION OF POWERS) RULES, 1984
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, Part I, Ist May,
1985]
No. S.O.R ‑III‑13‑1/81.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred on him by section 23 of the Punjab Civil
Servants Act, 1974, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following
rules, namely :‑
1. (1) These rules may be
called the Directorate of Reclamation and Probation (Delegation of Powers)
Rules, 1984.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. (1) Notwithstanding any
provision to the contrary in any service rules for the time being in force in
the Province or any part thereof, the authorities for the purpose of
appointment, punishments and appeals, in respect of each person holding post
mentioned in column 2 of the schedule annexed here with shall be such as is
specified against the post of such person in columns 3 to 7 of the said
schedule.
(2) Any authority empowered under these rules to impose a
penalty on the holder of a post shall be competent to impose such penalty on
every person holding such post whether such person was appointed by that
authority or not.
3. (1) The Punjab Reclamation and Probation Department
(Delegation of Powers) Rules, 1973, hereinafter referred to as the 1973 Rules
are hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1973 Rules, any
departmental enquiry, proceedings or action pending immediately before coming
into force of these rules shall be completed and order passed by the authority
as if the 1973 Rules, had not been repealed.
